name: Fichtenschloss & Fichtensee Rosenalm
kurzbeschreibung: Fichtenschloss on the Rosenalm in Zell am Ziller at 1,700 m: over 5,000 m² wooden adventure world with four towers, climbing area, and swimmable Fichtensee.
beschreibung:
Overview

The monumental Fichtenschloss and Fichtensee are situated on the sun-blessed Rosenalm above the market town of Zell am Ziller in the heart of Tyrol's Zillertal valley (Schwaz district) at an altitude of approximately 1,700 metres. Built by Zillertal Arena in 2016, this fascinating adventure landscape extends across a natural wooden playground spanning more than 5,000 square metres made from local timber. Located right by the mountain station of the Rosenalmbahn cable car and framed by the mighty mountain peaks of the Zillertal and Tux Alps, the site represents one of the most spectacular alpine play spaces in western Austria.

Four Adventure Towers, Climbing Realm & Fichtensee

The Fichtenschloss (Spruce Tree Castle) features four prominent wooden towers interconnected by suspension bridges, tube slides, and climbing nets. The central highlight is the 18-metre-high observation tower: its covered viewing platform commands a breathtaking 360-degree panorama of the entire Zillertal valley and the glaciated 3,000-metre peaks of the main Alpine ridge. The Rutschenturm (slide tower) offers fast descents through steep enclosed tunnels, while the Kletterturm (climbing tower) and the spruce gnome workshop challenge youthful building skills. The attraction also features a shaded water play area with wooden piston pumps, a wooden marble run, and a large barbecue area with brick fireplaces. A pram-friendly, ten-minute stroll leads visitors to the picturesque Fichtensee: in midsummer, the crystal-clear mountain lake is an inviting spot for a refreshing swim. Guests can rent stand-up paddleboards, walk across floating wooden pontoons, jump into the cool water from the diving pier, or unwind on ergonomic wooden loungers across scenic viewing terraces.

Visit & Getting There

The Fichtenschloss and Fichtensee are open daily during the summer season from late May to early October from 08:30 to 17:00. Admission to the Fichtenschloss and Fichtensee is free—visitors only need a cable car ticket for the Rosenalmbahn. Summer 2025/2026 fares: ascent and descent on the Rosenalmbahn (Sections I & II) adults approx. €31.50, youth approx. €25.00, children approx. €14.00, children under 6 ride free. Holders of the regional Zillertal Activcard ride the cable car free of charge! By car: take the Inntal autobahn A12 (exit Wiesing/Zillertal), continue on the B169 up the valley for about 20 km to Zell am Ziller, following the signs to the Zillertal Arena / Rosenalmbahn valley station (large free parking lots at Rohr 23). By public transport: Zillertalbahn train to Zell am Ziller railway station, where free shuttle buses run directly to the Rosenalmbahn valley station.

Tips

The 8-seater Rosenalmbahn gondola, the pathways throughout the castle grounds, and the shoreline trail around Fichtensee are barrier-free and very easy to navigate with prams. At the castle barbecue areas, a grill master is on hand daily from 11:00 to 14:00; barbecue sausage packs can be purchased on-site. Pack swimwear and towels so you can make the most of swimming in the pristine mountain waters of Fichtensee.
